summary: One church, St. Clare, Clifton; weekday Masses and Adoration are in the Divine Mercy Chapel (in the parish office on the same grounds) except Fridays. Both bulletins read (Nov 8, Nov 15) print the same schedule box; Adoration before each Mass has no printed end time, so it is recorded without one. Confession Saturday 3:00-3:45 PM per the bulletin (website says 3:30); a dated 9:00 AM Mass on Thu Nov 19 comes from the intentions. No open questions.
